GFL Environmental Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Raises Full Year 2026 Guidance

 

·Revenue, Adjusted EBITDA1 and Adjusted Free Cash Flow1 all ahead of expectations

 

·Underlying Adjusted EBITDA margin1 expansion of 115 basis points, excluding the impacts of M&A and diesel prices

 

·7.4% organic revenue growth, accelerating sequentially by 100 basis points

 

·Adjusted EBITDA1 of $678.7 million, increase of 26.8%; Adjusted Net Income from continuing operations1 of $100.1 million; Net loss from continuing operations of $28.0 million

 

·Year-to-date completed acquisitions generating approximately $2 billion in annualized revenue

 

·Raised full year 2026 guidance for the third time this year; now expecting low-to-mid 20s growth for revenue and Adjusted EBITDA2 and over 30% growth for Adjusted Free Cash Flow2

 

MIAMI BEACH, FL, October 28, 2026 — GFL Environmental Inc. (NYSE: GFL) (TSX: GFL) (“GFL”, “we”, “our”, or the “Company”) today announced its results for the third quarter of 2026.

 

“Once again we delivered better than expected results this quarter, thanks to the hard work and commitment of our over 17,000 employees,” said Patrick Dovigi, Founder and Chief Executive Officer of GFL. “In the quarter, we generated industry leading organic revenue growth of 7.4% and underlying Adjusted EBITDA margin1 expansion of more than 115 basis points. The ongoing strength of our financial performance in the face of a challenging macroeconomic backdrop further underscores the resiliency of our business model and effectiveness of our strategies. Given our strong results year to date and the expected contribution from our acquisition of SECURE Waste Infrastructure Corp., we are raising our 2026 full year guidance for the third time this year.”

 

Mr. Dovigi continued, “During the third quarter, we formed a Special Committee of independent directors to review unsolicited inbound proposals to take the Company private. The Special Committee has provided interested parties with a final deadline of November 9, 2026 to deliver their updated proposals, at which time the Special Committee will determine next steps. The strong interest from leading global institutional investors is a testament to the hard work of our team and the quality of the business we have built. While the Special Committee completes its review, our team remains laser focused on delivering on our strategic plan that we laid out at our last investor day including driving outsized margin expansion in the base business and improving Adjusted Free Cash Flow1 conversion toward the mid 40% range.”

 

GFL also announced that pursuant to the terms of the previously announced acquisition of SECURE Waste Infrastructure Corp. (“SECURE”), Joseph Lenz will join GFL’s Board of Directors as the SECURE nominee, increasing the size of the Board to nine directors. Mr. Lenz brings with him a wealth of experience as a Firm Partner at TPG, as well as having served on the SECURE board since 2022.
